name: New Castle

holders.name: Mike Guffey
holders.note: City page calls the districts Wards; Ward 1

council_map.vintage: UNCLEAR, possibly OLD. The PDF (posted to the site in Sept 2026) carries the footer 'COMPILED USING 2010 CENSUS DATA'. It labels 16 precincts, grouped into 5 wards. I could not tell if a post-2020 redraw exists.
council_map.notes: Map labels precincts (ward 1 = precincts 8, 11, 12; ward 2 = 1, 4, 9, 13 (green); ward 3 = 2, 3, 7 (yellow); ward 4 = 14, 15, 16; ward 5 = 5, 6, 10 by my reading of the picture and the legend colours). The search summary said city code section 30.15 lists precincts per ward, but amlegal pages are script-rendered, so the code text was not saved (raw/new-castle-in/code30.html is an empty shell). No ArcGIS layer found (the city lists a GIS/Maps department; Henry County GIS office exists; not opened). The ward map is a vector PDF with no extractable text.

notes: The council page does NOT say who was appointed mid-term. The city site was redesigned: the www host serves some old pages and a 'redesigned' notice on others; all facts are from cityofnewcastle.net pages saved in raw/new-castle-in/. The Government page lists a 'City Court' (raw/new-castle-in/government.html); judge not collected. Council page states: 5 Ward Representatives and 2 At-Large; meetings 1st and 3rd Monday 6:30 PM.
